note: Variadic fns are not :direct-callable?, so this fixture stays on the VM trampoline on purpose. It scopes the direct-call evidence: the gate must reject a trampoline where it demands a direct call, and vice versa. It also carries the inverted semantic mutant (dead_native_body_mutant_survives): SumAll is emitted but never called, so wrapping its returned expression must NOT change the program — still builds, exits 0, prints byte-exact .expect. A surviving mutant here is required evidence that the generated body is dead and ec.Invoke is what runs.
